purpose: Rank the data still worth acquiring after deliberate over-acquisition. More rows from already-covered contexts rank below missing outcome/linkage dimensions.

gaps.gap: authorised real-site shot-linked intervention and recovery histories
gaps.target: shot/cycle ID -> machine/tool/cavity -> exact material lot -> process actuals -> cavity/tool signals -> physical defect/quality -> action -> verified recovery
gaps.why: This remains the largest difference between strong mechanism evidence and production-grade diagnostic validation.

gaps.target: first answer, distractor, response time, confidence, retry, lesson exposure and later transfer performance
gaps.why: External learner datasets can test analytics code but cannot calibrate MouldMaster item difficulty/discrimination.

gaps.target: at least three independent engineers per diagnostic case before app output is revealed
gaps.why: Required to quantify diagnostic agreement, calibration and disagreement with real experts.

gaps.target: multiple machines/tools, normal and abnormal cycles, actual failure cause and corrective action
gaps.why: Several excellent industrial corpora are request-only or company-restricted.

gaps.target: wear/deposit/fouling progression -> maintenance trigger -> repair/cleaning -> post-maintenance recovery
gaps.why: Controlled NRV and simulated extraction faults are now well covered, but naturally accumulated lifecycle histories remain scarce.

gaps.target: zone actual temperature, heater current/output, valve-pin actual state, alarms, nozzle/manifold state, cavity response and quality
gaps.why: Current evidence contains measured hot-runner systems but little rights-clear raw actual-state telemetry.

gaps.gap: longitudinal cooling fouling and cleaning histories
gaps.target: flow, inlet/outlet temperature, pressure drop, water quality, fouling progression, cleaning action and quality/energy recovery
gaps.why: Cooling actuals and contamination mechanisms are now independently supported, but long-duration raw histories are still missing.

gaps.target: per-cavity pressure/temperature/weight/dimension/defect with runner/gate state and cavity identity
gaps.why: Existing multicavity studies improve mechanism confidence but broader raw cavity-by-cavity outcome data would strengthen transfer.

gaps.gap: full raw admission of high-value public candidates
gaps.target: OpenMMS, EPP raw workbook, RWTH PCR archive, LEGO six-machine appendix and other executable sources
gaps.why: The discovery problem is solved for these sources; deterministic retrieval, hashing, profiling and rights admission now create more value than additional citations.

gaps.target: immutable manufacturer PDS fingerprint plus supplier/lot/regrind/moisture/conditioning tied to measured moulding cases
gaps.why: Exact-grade source candidates are growing, but plant-shot material lot identity remains much rarer.

gaps.target: component-specific injection actuals, interface/core position, hot-runner actuals and physical bond/dimensional outcomes
gaps.why: 2K/overmoulding mechanism evidence is now broad, but most raw production datasets are request-only.

gaps.gap: more real measured-data assessments with psychometric outcomes
gaps.target: trace/case questions using rights-clear measured evidence, followed by real learner difficulty/discrimination statistics
gaps.why: Question construction is no longer the main bottleneck; calibration and rights-clear measured evidence are.

deprioritised: more generic time-series rows from already-covered single-machine contexts
simulation datasets without new geometry/process coverage
papers that duplicate an already staged experiment
model-generated QA presented as domain ground truth
